mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last quarter indicates a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of quarters with positive GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last two months signals an expansion in supply, which increases competition and reduces corporate pricing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with joint increases in HOUST and RSAFS, or the joint effect of these increases on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in consumer price index signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production coupled with an increase in the consumer price index signals supply constraints in an inflationary environment, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of INDPRO decreases and CPIAUCSL increases on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
